title: dbt → warehouse → tests → docs
description: Transform raw landed data into a tested, documented star schema with dbt, and gate every change on data-aware CI.

implementation.Staging: rename, cast, one row per source row.

implementation.Intermediate: business logic, no direct consumer reads.

implementation.Marts: fct vs dim, grain declared in schema.yml.

implementation: Incremental on fct_orders with a 3-day lookback.
repo_structure:
dbt-warehouse-tests/
  models/staging/
  models/intermediate/
  models/marts/
  models/schema.yml     # tests + descriptions
  tests/                # singular tests
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
architecture:
raw.orders ─▶ stg_orders ─▶ int_orders_enriched ─┐
raw.customers ─▶ stg_customers ──────────────────┼─▶ fct_orders ─▶ marts
seeds/ ─▶ dim_date ──────────────────────────────┘
            (tests + docs on every node; CI on staging schema)
